ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximately 0.35:0.65 ratio of high-intensity white/grey pixels to low-intensity black/dark-grey pixels on visible surfaces.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Extensive white mottling and grey-scale pixel clusters concentrated on the distal regions of the lobes, with isolated high-intensity circular nodes scattered across the central dark-pixel fields.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations on the right lobe trailing edge with pixel-depth variations between 4-12 pixels; left lobe edge appears smoother with lower-amplitude peaks.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Pronounced concave curvature along the trailing edges tapering to acute points at the lateral tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular, high-contrast rings (dark centers with white perimeters) clustered on the mid-right lobe and scattered across the left visible surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several faint, unaligned diagonal linear pixel disruptions visible across the mid-section of the right lobe surface.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Dense, protruding clusters of calcified biological matter (barnacles) localized on the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Heavy barnacle colonization on the fluke tips creating a jagged, non-organic geometric profile relative to the natural trailing edge.
